import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile

source = Path.cwd()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="devlyn-instructions-acceptance-") as temporary:
    root = Path(temporary)
    pack_argv = ["npm", "pack", "--ignore-scripts", "--json", "--pack-destination", str(root)]
    packed = subprocess.run(pack_argv, cwd=source, env=dict(os.environ, npm_config_cache=str(root / "npm-cache")), capture_output=True)
    print(json.dumps({"pack_argv": pack_argv, "exit_code": packed.returncode}), flush=True)
    sys.stderr.buffer.write(packed.stderr)
    sys.stderr.buffer.flush()
    if packed.returncode:
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(packed.stdout)
        sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
        packed.check_returncode()
    package_file = root / json.loads(packed.stdout)[0]["filename"]
    with tarfile.open(package_file) as archive:
        archive.extractall(root, filter="data")
    package = root / "package"
    template = package / "AGENTS.md"
    for name in ("AGENTS.md", "CLAUDE.md"):
        actual = (package / name).read_bytes()
        assert actual == (source / name).read_bytes(), name
    print(json.dumps({"package": str(package_file), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(package_file.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "entry_parity": True}), flush=True)
    preload = root / "owned-home.cjs"
    preload.write_text("require('os').homedir = () => process.env.DEVLYN_INSTALL_TEST_HOME;\n")
    custom = b"# Customer instructions\r\n\r\nPreserve this exact content.\r\n"
    legacy = b"# Customer instructions\n\nKeep me.\n\n---\n# Devlyn Agent Instructions\nRetired evaluator.\n"
    cases = [
        ("missing", None, template.read_bytes(), False),
        ("custom", custom, custom, True),
        ("current", template.read_bytes(), template.read_bytes(), True),
        ("legacy", legacy, b"# Customer instructions\n\nKeep me.\n", False),
    ]
    for name, before, expected, notice_expected in cases:
        work = root / name
        home = root / ("home-" + name)
        work.mkdir()
        home.mkdir()
        destination = work / "AGENTS.md"
        if before is not None:
            destination.write_bytes(before)
        environment = dict(os.environ, DEVLYN_INSTALL_TEST_HOME=str(home))
        argv = ["node", "--require", str(preload), str(package / "bin/devlyn.js"), "agents", "codex"]
        result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=work, env=environment, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
        print(json.dumps({"case": name, "argv": argv, "exit_code": result.returncode}), flush=True)
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(result.stdout)
        sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
        sys.stderr.buffer.write(result.stderr)
        sys.stderr.buffer.flush()
        assert result.returncode == 0, name
        actual = destination.read_bytes()
        assert actual == expected, name
        output = result.stdout.decode("utf-8")
        preservation_notice = any("AGENTS.md" in line and "preserv" in line.lower() for line in output.splitlines())
        assert preservation_notice == notice_expected, name
        if notice_expected:
            assert str(template) in output, name
            assert "outdated" not in output.lower(), name
        skills = home / ".codex" / "skills"
        for skill in ("devlyn:resolve", "devlyn:ideate", "devlyn:design-ui", "devlyn:engines", "devlyn:queue"):
            installed = skills / skill / "SKILL.md"
            assert installed.is_file(), (name, skill)
        assert (skills / "_shared" / "resolve-bootstrap.py").read_bytes() == (package / "config/skills/_shared/resolve-bootstrap.py").read_bytes(), name
        assert (skills / ".devlyn-install.json").is_file(), name
        print(json.dumps({"case": name, "before_base64": None if before is None else base64.b64encode(before).decode(), "after_base64": base64.b64encode(actual).decode(), "notice": preservation_notice, "skills_installed": True}), flush=True)
    print("INSTALLER_ACCEPTANCE_PASS cases=4 package_entries=2")
PY
